messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — weekly dashboard shows 1,120 webinar signups but CRM only ingested 860. can anyone confirm if this is a routing mismatch or dupes?

drew: ugh. saw a smaller gap yesterday but not that big. where are you pulling the 1,120 from? which view?

maria: the marketing -> weekly-kpis Looker tile (last 7 days). filter = webinar_campaign:launch-apr.

sasha: metrics-bot just posted GA4 export finished at 09:02 with 1,145 unique registrations (event: webinar_reg).

metrics-bot: GA4 to BigQuery export completed — table: analytics.events_2026_03; rows: 2,341,712; webinar_reg events: 1,145

olivia: ok so GA4 1,145 vs Looker 1,120 vs CRM 860. the 25 diff between GA4 and Looker could be filter/window. the big gap is CRM ingestion.

maria: @drew can you run an attribution join on ga4->mql pipeline? maybe UTM parsing failed for some signups so they didn't route to CRM.

drew: on it. quick check shows ~220 rows where utm_medium IS NULL but they have a gclid. looks like the landing page script didn't populate utm params on chrome 112+.

sasha: wow. that matches the surge on Mar 18 when we had the paid push.

lucas: for the CRM side, we also had a temporary validation rule that dropped records missing company_size. i raised a ticket last week — maybe those 220 were blocked.

maria: can you confirm, @lucas? if true we need a backfill and a one-pager for the execs.

lucas: confirmed — validation rule FR-827 active 03/17-03/19. it rejected ~198 leads with missing company_size. i've queued a backfill job to retry with nulls allowed and owner=ops-temp. ETA 2h.

drew: here's the debug SQL I ran to surface the mismatch:
```sql
SELECT e.user_pseudo_id, e.event_timestamp, e.params.key, e.params.value
FROM `analytics.events_2026_03` e
WHERE e.event_name = 'webinar_reg'
  AND e.event_date BETWEEN '2026-03-16' AND '2026-03-20'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crm.leads l WHERE l.email = e.user_email)
LIMIT 100;
```

olivia: nice. can we add a column for gclid vs utm presence and run cohort counts? if many are gclid-only we should map those into paid campaign attribution in Looker.

sasha: agreed. also recommend we add a card to next weekly KPI review showing "registration ingestion loss" with a breakdown: validation rule rejects, missing utm, duplicate emails.

maria: yes please. @drew @lucas can you both add the counts to the KPI board before Friday's weekly review? we'll need numbers + proposed remediation steps.

drew: will add counts and two suggested fixes: (1) update landing script to always backfill utm from referrer/gclid decoding, (2) add server-side fallback that pins utm to session.

lucas: will add rejected-leads backfill plan + list of rejected ids to the board.

metrics-bot: Dashboard card updated: "registration ingestion loss" draft added to weekly-kpi dashboard by sasha at 14:27

olivia: also flagging potential attribution bias — if we retroactively assign those gclid-only to paid, our paid CPA will go up for last week. want the paid channel owners to know before the review.

maria: good point. @sasha can you ping ad-ops and include an estimate of CPA delta?

sasha: pinged @ad-ops in DMs and asked them to join Friday 9:30. estimate coming after backfill completes.

drew: small note: dedupe rules differ between Looker and CRM. Looker dedup is by event_cookie whereas CRM is by email. that will remain a source of divergence even after backfill.

maria: noted. add a short explainer to the KPI card: "dedupe by cookie vs dedupe by contact -> expected variance."

olivia: any quick wins for the March numbers so execs don't freak?

lucas: I can push partial backfill of the 198 rejected leads in ~45m so CRM will show ~1,058. still shy of Looker but narrows the gap.

sasha: do it. we'll present the timeline and show that the remaining delta is attribution/dedup issues.

maria: thanks team. last asks: (1) @drew add cohort table to the KPI card, (2) @lucas run backfill and post job id, (3) @sasha prep 3-slide note for Friday on impact + next steps.

drew: done — cohort counts added (paid: 672, organic: 448, unknown/gclid-only: 220)

lucas: backfill job started — job_id: bf-20260318-77, ETA 32m

metrics-bot: backfill job bf-20260318-77 completed — 186 leads re-ingested, 12 failures (validation fallback needed).

maria: updated notes — CRM now shows 1,046 ingested. good progress. we'll walk through on Friday. :thumbsup:

sasha: I'll also add a recommended change to the landing page script story in the backlog with priority P1.

olivia: closing loop for now. appreciate the fast turnaround. :rocket:
